description: Demo MCP server exposing a fake Zava IT support knowledge base and ticket system. For showcasing Agent 365 BYO MCP governance.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the Zava internal knowledge base. Returns matching articles with id, title and summary.

tools.name: get_support_ticket
tools.description: Get a Zava support ticket by id (for example ZAVA-1001). Returns status, priority, owner and summary.

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Create a new Zava support ticket. priority must be Low, Medium or High. Returns the new ticket id.
